name: Built-in screen rotation
description: With the laptop on its left or right side, or upside down, the built-in panels are turned, and two panels are put side by side, or one below the other, also with a keyboard or a mouse connected. Each panel can also be turned by hand, on its own, from the quick settings: for two people who sit opposite each other. Made for the two panels of the ASUS Zenbook Duo UX8406. The switch "Auto-rotate" in the quick settings turns the sensor on and off. The sensor needs iio-sensor-proxy; check with monitor-sensor that it gives the right orientation (the README on the project page says how to correct it).
